text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She ran into Little Cocon and Bitter 
Glasse at the sporting goods store.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Happy Meek continued her self-training 
late into the night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking ahead to their upcoming 'Year 3,' 
each of the girls expresses care and deep 
trust in their Trainers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by the sight, they vowed to 
redouble their efforts and forge ahead 
together with <chrname>!
